About us

At S99 we help brands grow, connect and stand out through creative marketing strategies, content production and performance-driven campaigns.

S99 was founded in 2024 by Ahmed Saleh, the agency’s founder and owner. Since then we have partnered with businesses across hospitality, healthcare, retail, tourism and finance to build strong brand identities, grow their audiences and deliver measurable results. One team covers strategy, social media, production and influencers — from the first idea to the final cut.
